problems.title: The manual import step should not exist
problems.call: Four CSV imports done by hand for two customers, each one an evening of SQL. Customer 100 would cost exactly the same as customer 2. Then you asked "are you sure?" three times instead of checking one real upload.

quote.text: "possibly the most common error of a smart engineer is to optimize the thing that should not exist"

evidence.summary: Imports on 6, 13, 22 and 28 Oct for two customers; 3 of 8 prompts on 28 Oct asked whether it was right.

prompts.quote: import this customer's CSV again, same columns as last time
give me the SQL to fix the totals for this account
are you sure the totals match now?

problems.old: Fix this customer's data by hand, then ask the AI if it's right.
problems.new: Delete the manual step. Build the import once. Prove it on a real upload.

steps.name: Question the requirement
steps.text: Who said imports need you? Nobody. It's a habit.

steps.name: Delete
steps.text: No more hand SQL for imports, starting with the next one.

steps.name: Simplify
steps.text: One CSV template and one validation rule.

steps.name: Accelerate

steps.name: Automate
steps.text: Only then does the upload check totals by itself.

deadline.done: Done means one real customer upload lands with no SQL.
